issue_request: FHIR-5370 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 ballot correction asking to fix the Documentation Index path where clicking the BackboneElement link under the old "Infrastructure Types" section produced headings prefixed with "??" such as "?.?.1 Content". The resolution said the content was not registered in the hierarchy and the broken index should be fixed.

Git history shows the old Infrastructure Types block and standalone backboneelement.html link existed in 2014 and were later removed by a documentation layout refactor.
additional_context: The current Documentation Index links to Type Framework rather than the old Infrastructure Types/BackboneElement path. source/hierarchy.xml registers Documentation Index and Type Framework/types.html in the current page hierarchy. Current build output for types.html#BackboneElement has a real section count, and bounded Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later conflicting decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because current source and current build already satisfy the issue's documentation hierarchy and section-numbering intent.
